title: 1 market or multiple?
author: GlitchReality63
selftext:
I’ve built arbitrage bots for prediction markets,   
Futures NQ, alpaca stocks, kraken 10k funded. Genuinely curious does everyone do this kinda of spread? Or do most of yall stick to one market? I like to build and test so that’s what causes to me to expand around. They all run themselves; research loops, kill, promote, shadow test so I don’t see the issue with having all of em but idk im still new to this whole thing.

comments.author: mdawe1
comments.body: One market at a time my friend... it is going to be harder then you think. Dont divide your brain power

replies.author: GlitchReality63
replies.body: This is fair, I have found that with many projects it does start getting hard to give it the attention it deserves
